<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 390 844">
  <defs>
    <filter id="shadow" x="-20%" y="-20%" width="140%" height="140%">
      <feDropShadow dx="0" dy="2" stdDeviation="3" flood-color="#063336" flood-opacity=".10"/>
    </filter>
  </defs>

  <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="844" fill="#F9FAFA"/>

  <!-- Status bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="0" width="390" height="30" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <text x="22" y="19" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#121212">9:41</text>
    <line x1="334" y1="18" x2="338" y2="18" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="341" y1="15" x2="345" y2="18" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <line x1="348" y1="12" x2="352" y2="18" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="2"/>
    <circle cx="361" cy="16" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <line x1="361" y1="12" x2="361" y2="10" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <rect x="370" y="11" width="16" height="10" rx="2" fill="none" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.4"/>
    <rect x="372" y="13" width="11" height="6" rx="1" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="387" y1="14" x2="387" y2="18" stroke="#121212" stroke-width="1.4"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Header -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="30" width="390" height="62" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <polyline points="29,61 21,68 29,75" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <line x1="22" y1="68" x2="39" y2="68" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="2.3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
    <text x="54" y="66" font-family="Poppins" font-size="20" font-weight="500" fill="#0A2533">Order details</text>
    <rect x="347" y="52" width="17" height="19" rx="5" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="355.5" cy="49" r="3" fill="none" stroke="#0A2533" stroke-width="1.7"/>
    <circle cx="365" cy="53" r="4" fill="#EC2A38"/>
    <text x="363" y="55.5" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="7" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">1</text>
    <line x1="0" y1="91" x2="390" y2="91" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1"/>
  </g>

  <!-- Order summary -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="108" width="354" height="132" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <rect x="32" y="123" width="72" height="72" rx="9" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <circle cx="81" cy="139" r="7" fill="#FFAE1B"/>
    <polygon points="43,181 57,157 68,169 78,152 97,181" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polygon points="43,181 57,164 66,174 78,159 97,181" fill="#4B9460"/>
    <text x="119" y="132" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">ORDER ID</text>
    <text x="119" y="153" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">#3339</text>
    <rect x="119" y="164" width="84" height="22" rx="11" fill="#F3FAF6"/>
    <text x="161" y="179" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#267347">On the way</text>
    <text x="32" y="218" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Placed on October 24, 2024 at 12:18 PM</text>
    <text x="348" y="134" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Total</text>
    <text x="348" y="154" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-size="17" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">$27.40</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Delivery status heading -->
  <g>
    <text x="20" y="275" font-family="Poppins" font-size="18" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">Delivery status</text>
    <text x="20" y="297" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Estimated arrival today, 1:05–1:20 PM</text>
    <rect x="284" y="266" width="86" height="29" rx="14" fill="#D4FCBC"/>
    <text x="327" y="285" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="500" fill="#267347">18 min away</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Timeline card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="315" width="354" height="280" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <line x1="57" y1="365" x2="57" y2="537" stroke="#ADD993" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="355" r="12" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="51,355 55,359 63,350" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="414" r="12" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="51,414 55,418 63,409" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="477" r="12" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <polyline points="51,477 55,481 63,472" fill="none" stroke="#FFFFFF" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="540" r="12" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="3"/>
    <circle cx="57" cy="540" r="5" fill="#5DB329"/>

    <text x="84" y="352" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">Order confirmed</text>
    <text x="84" y="371" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Chinese Kitchen accepted your order</text>
    <text x="344" y="352" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">12:19 PM</text>

    <text x="84" y="411" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">Preparing your food</text>
    <text x="84" y="430" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Your meal is being freshly prepared</text>
    <text x="344" y="411" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">12:27 PM</text>

    <text x="84" y="474" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">Picked up by courier</text>
    <text x="84" y="493" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Alex is on the way to your address</text>
    <text x="344" y="474" text-anchor="end" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">12:47 PM</text>

    <text x="84" y="537" font-family="Poppins" font-size="14" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">Arriving soon</text>
    <text x="84" y="556" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">We’ll notify you when they arrive</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Route card -->
  <g filter="url(#shadow)">
    <rect x="18" y="615" width="354" height="119" rx="10" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  </g>
  <g>
    <text x="32" y="640" font-family="Poppins" font-size="15" font-weight="600" fill="#0A2533">Delivery route</text>
    <circle cx="42" cy="666" r="5" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <line x1="42" y1="671" x2="42" y2="699" stroke="#C7C7C7" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <circle cx="42" cy="704" r="5" fill="#0A2533"/>
    <text x="59" y="670" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Chinese Kitchen</text>
    <text x="59" y="686" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">18 Market Street</text>
    <text x="59" y="708" font-family="Poppins" font-size="12" font-weight="500" fill="#333333">Home delivery</text>
    <text x="59" y="724" font-family="Poppins" font-size="11" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">42 Willow Avenue, Apt 3B</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Bottom action -->
  <g>
    <rect x="18" y="748" width="170" height="41" rx="20" fill="#5DB329"/>
    <text x="103" y="774" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#FFFFFF">Contact courier</text>
    <rect x="202" y="748" width="170" height="41" rx="20" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#5DB329" stroke-width="1.5"/>
    <text x="287" y="774" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="13" font-weight="500" fill="#4B9460">Get help</text>
  </g>

  <!-- Navigation bar -->
  <g>
    <rect x="0" y="801" width="390" height="43" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
    <line x1="0" y1="801" x2="390" y2="801" stroke="#EEEEEE" stroke-width="1"/>
    <g>
      <polygon points="39,815 49,807 59,815 59,825 52,825 52,819 46,819 46,825 39,825" fill="#5DB329"/>
      <text x="49" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="500" fill="#5DB329">Home</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="130" cy="815" r="8" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7"/>
      <line x1="136" y1="821" x2="142" y2="827" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round"/>
      <text x="130" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Explore</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <rect x="208" y="809" width="17" height="14" rx="3" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <polygon points="212,823 216,827 219,823" fill="#666666"/>
      <text x="216" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Messages</text>
    </g>
    <g>
      <circle cx="310" cy="813" r="5" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <ellipse cx="310" cy="825" rx="10" ry="5" fill="none" stroke="#666666" stroke-width="1.6"/>
      <text x="310" y="839" text-anchor="middle" font-family="Poppins" font-size="10" font-weight="400" fill="#666666">Profile</text>
    </g>
  </g>
</svg>
